documents.name: Planning Commission Minutes - 2024-12-02
documents.synopsis: Official minutes of the December 2, 2024 Planning Commission meeting.
documents.description: PC approved Nov 4 minutes unanimously. Business: Kevin Rubenstein and Joe Cosentini presented informational updates on the Train Station renovation and South End Streetscape projects (no action required). Town updates: Enclave at Parkside SWM plan submitted to county; Danny Mican introduced as PC candidate (to be appointed Dec 9); Springfield Ave paving deferred to spring.

documents.name: County Updates
documents.synopsis: Carroll County planning update for February 3, 2025 Planning Commission meeting.
documents.description: County planning update provided for information purposes only.

documents.name: Staff Report
documents.original_filename: Staff Report - Schoolhouse Rd Accessory Building Introduction
documents.synopsis: Staff report introducing the Schoolhouse Road Apartments accessory building site plan (S-24-0033, parcel 4452, R-10,000).
documents.description: Introduction-only staff report for a site plan proposing a 672 sq ft two-story accessory building (community space/leasing office), ADA and EV parking upgrades, playground, sidewalks, and raised crosswalks at Schoolhouse Road Apartments. No action requested; plan still under Town and County review.

documents.name: Site Plan
documents.original_filename: Schoolhouse Rd Apartments - Accessory Building Site Plan (Feb 2025)
documents.synopsis: Site plan for Schoolhouse Road Apartments accessory building and site improvements.
documents.description: Site plan showing proposed accessory building, updated parking area with ADA and EV charging spaces, playground, sidewalks, raised crosswalks, and ADA unit access improvements at the Schoolhouse Road Apartment community.

documents.name: Staff Report
documents.synopsis: Staff report requesting Planning Commission approval of the 2024 MDP Annual Report for submittal to Carroll County.
documents.description: Staff report presenting the Maryland Department of Planning 2024 Annual Report data for PC approval per Land Use Article §1-207. Once approved, Chair Phil Singleton signs a certification letter to MDP confirming participation in the county-wide report.

documents.name: Annual Report
documents.synopsis: Town of Sykesville 2024 Annual Report submitted to Maryland Department of Planning.
documents.description: Five-page 2024 Annual Report documenting Sykesville planning activity: no new comprehensive plan amendments; one text amendment (Resolution 2024-01 adding automobile service garage as conditional use in B-L zone); no annexations or zoning map changes; no new parks or road changes.

documents.name: Certification Letter
documents.synopsis: Certification letter from Sykesville Planning Commission to Maryland Department of Planning confirming 2024 Annual Report approval.
documents.description: Signed letter from PC Chair Phil Singleton dated 02/03/2025 certifying that the Planning Commission approved the 2024 Annual Report data for inclusion in the Carroll County 2024 Annual Report per Land Use Article §1-207 and §1-208.

documents.name: Agenda
documents.description: Agenda for the February 3, 2025 regular Planning Commission meeting covering approval of December 2 minutes, county updates, introduction of Schoolhouse Road Apartments accessory building site plan (S-24-0033, no action), and approval of 2024 MDP Annual Report.

documents.name: Planning Commission Minutes - 2025-02-03
documents.synopsis: Official minutes of the February 3, 2025 Planning Commission meeting.
documents.description: PC approved Dec 2 minutes unanimously. Business: Schoolhouse Road Apartments accessory building (S-24-0033) introduced for informational purposes — no vote taken. MDP 2024 Annual Report approved unanimously; Chair Phil Singleton signed certification letter to Maryland Department of Planning. Town updates: Enclave at Parkside SWM plan under county review; Springfield Ave paving planned for spring.
